newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico 48-hr peso rally as foreigners step in.
newsitem.headline: Mexico 48-hr peso rally as foreigners step in.

text.p: Mexico's two main peso contracts closed sharply stronger Thursday as foreign investors stepped back into the Mexican markets and some local banks sold surplus dollar positions, traders said.
"Dealers had bought a lot of dollars amid the speculation we have seen in recent sessions...today's firmness is because they eventually sold their long (dollar) positions," said a trader.
The benchmark 48-hour and 24-hour contracts closed up 6.2 and 7.6 centavos, respectively, at 7.7100/7.7230 and 7.7030/7.70807 per dollar.
